welcome.title: Welcome to MagicAIBuilder
welcome.description: Build Commander decks with live bracket scoring, AI suggestions, and Scryfall integration. Let's walk you through the basics in 4 quick steps.

createDeck.title: Create your first deck
createDeck.description: Click "New Deck" at the top right of the page, or in the menu on a small screen. Give it a name, choose your format, and set a target bracket.
createDeck.hint: With an account, you can also click "Build with AI" on My Decks to build a full deck from scratch.

searchCards.title: Search & add cards
searchCards.description: Use the left search panel to find any MTG card. Click a result to add it to your deck. The first card you add as Commander will set your color identity.
searchCards.hint: Filter by color, type, or CMC to narrow results quickly.

trackStats.title: Track stats & bracket
trackStats.description: The right panel shows your live bracket score, game changers, mana curve, and AI suggestions. Keep an eye on the bracket indicator to stay in your pod's range.
trackStats.hint: Hover over the bracket badge to see which cards are pushing your score up.
